scheme_name: Financial Assistance to WW II Veteran and Widows of WW II Veterans
other_conditions: Applicant must be an ex‑serviceman of the Pre‑Independence Era (World War II veteran) who enrolled before 31 August 1945, or the widower of such a veteran
Only other ranks (Havildar and below) are eligible
Applicant must have an annual income from all sources below ₹2,00,000
Applicant must not be receiving any pension, financial assistance, or maintenance allowance from any Government department or any organization controlled by the Government
Applicants with any income from a job, profession, or business are not eligible
The applicant must be a bonafide resident of Haryana and provide a domicile certificate issued by the competent authority and an attested copy of the Ration Card
Survival verification proof must be submitted every year in April; failure to do so will stop payments
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 per month is provided to eligible World War II veterans and their widows.
documents_required: Domicile certificate issued by the competent authority as authorized by the Haryana Government
Attested copy of the Ration Card
